headline: EVERY REVIEW.
EVERY COMPETITOR.
AS JSON.
lede: G2's official API is enterprise-only — a sales call before you see a single row. This Actor is an unofficial G2 API: reviews, product profiles, category listings, alternatives and the category directory. Reviewer job title, industry, company segment and size on every review. More than 100 reviews per product.
